style_summary: Buenos Aires fileteado porteño translated into a modern poster and label system: a symmetrical, fully enclosed panel of glossy hand-painted enamel ornament on a dark contra-field, built from acanthus leaves ending in volutes, a thick modeled band, flat flowers, ribbons, dots and thin firulete lines, with gothic fish-tail lettering that has a projected body, cast shadow and white highlight strokes. It reads like a painted bus panel or shop-front sign, while subject, words and field color change completely each time.

environment_variables.SUBJECT: central emblem or object inside the panel (instrument, product, animal, building) that the ornament frames
environment_variables.SUBJECT_ACTION: how the emblem is presented: held by a ribbon, flanked by mirrored dragons or birds, rising from a cornucopia
environment_variables.PRODUCT_OR_PROP: secondary ornamental props: flowers, fruit, horseshoe, bunting, cornucopia, scroll cartouche
environment_variables.LOCATION: painted surface the panel sits on: bus side, shop sign, label, wooden board, enamel plaque
environment_variables.BACKGROUND_ELEMENTS: filigree spirals, dots and drops filling the empty corners of the panel
environment_variables.MAIN_TEXT: exact short phrase or name painted in large gothic fileteado lettering
environment_variables.SECONDARY_TEXT: exact small supporting line painted in a simple signwriter script
environment_variables.ACCENT_SYMBOL: small symbolic motif such as a heart, star, horseshoe or shield placed on the central axis
environment_variables.WARDROBE_STYLE: surface finish and detailing: pearlescent or wood-grain contra-field, gold outline, pearl beads on the letters
environment_variables.FIELD_COLOR: dominant dark contra-field color behind the ornament (for example deep red, black, dark brown or midnight blue)
environment_variables.STYLE_FIDELITY_ANCHORS: Runtime ordered CORE and FLEX style anchors
environment_variables.SOURCE_CONTENT_TO_AVOID: Runtime source identities and content to replace

style_fidelity_anchors: [CORE] The whole composition sits inside a clearly painted frame, with a deliberate margin (the talon) between frame and ornament, so it reads as a self-contained panel rather than a poster with free-floating decoration.

[CORE] Near-obsessive symmetry: the left and right halves mirror each other around a central axis, or follow a strict asymmetric balance with the heavier mass on the left and the band completing the right.
[CORE] A thick banda with visible volume runs along the border and, together with acanthus leaves, structures the entire layout; a much thinner firulete line accompanies the band at an even distance.

[CORE] Acanthus leaves that end in volutes are the main ornament; each leaf differs slightly in shape or direction, ribs are marked with a brighter tone, and smaller dense spirals (filigree) fill gaps.

[CORE] Every motif has painted volume: a flat base color first, then a light tone on the side facing the light, a dark tone on the opposite side, and crisp pure-white highlight strokes along ribs and bevels.
[CORE] Light comes from above or the upper left; each motif casts a hard, flat shadow onto the contra-field on the lower right.
[CORE] Saturated enamel colors on a dark contra-field: luminous green, ochre or gold, pink, light blue and pure white, with high gloss and strong contrast.

[CORE] Lettering uses gothic or highly ornamented fileteado capitals with fish-tail terminals, a projected body toward the lower left, a cast shadow to the right, a bevel highlight and optional pearl beads or an inner color band.

[FLEX] Flat flowers are built from a circle divided into four or five equal concave petals with a small gap between them, an inner shadow and a convex center with white stamens; tulip and bell-shaped flowers may be added.
[FLEX] Ribbons in folded perspective, small round dots (bolitas) and teardrops fill empty spaces and corners; the composition is rich and almost overfull, never sparse.
[FLEX] Optional animal or symbolic figures integrated into the leaves: dragons for strength, birds, horses, or a cornucopia overflowing with flowers and fruit.
[FLEX] Optional long pinstripe lines and bracket-like curls (bigoteado) painted with a long-haired brush along edges and dividing color planes.
source_content_to_avoid: Do not copy any specific artist's finished design, signature, workshop mark or the exact panels, plates and layouts shown in the reference books.
Do not reproduce book pages, diagrams, step-by-step drawing exercises, captions or any printed text from the references.
No real company logos, brand names, bus line numbers, license plates, football club crests or political symbols.
No misspelled or invented words: only the exact supplied MAIN_TEXT and SECONDARY_TEXT may appear as lettering.
Do not use the Argentine flag as a literal national flag; light blue and white ribbons are allowed only as decorative bands.
No watermarks, QR codes, handles, platform interface or photograph borders.

visual_deconstruction.overall_style_category: Argentine decorative enamel painting (fileteado porteño) adapted to posters, shop signs and labels.
visual_deconstruction.composition_logic: A closed panel built in levels: outer frame, margin, thick band with leaves, thin firulete, inner level of lighter ornament, and a central emblem on the axis.
visual_deconstruction.ornament_system: Acanthus leaves with volutas, flat flowers, ribbons, filigree spirals, dots and teardrops, with optional dragons, birds or a cornucopia.
visual_deconstruction.volume_logic: Concave and convex reading on every form: convex parts lit on top, concave parts shaded on top and lit below, with bright repique strokes on ribs.
visual_deconstruction.lettering: Gothic fileteado capitals with fish-tail ends, body projected left and down, cast shadow right, bevel highlight and pearls.
visual_deconstruction.mood: Warm, proud, festive and handmade: neighborhood craft with a lot of polish.

composition.layout: One enclosed panel with a painted frame and an even margin; ornament mirrored around a central vertical axis, with lettering on a ribbon, cartouche or central band.
composition.hierarchy: Central emblem and headline first, then the main acanthus and band structure, then flowers and ribbons, then filigree, dots and firulete.
composition.levels: Draw the heavier outer level first, then a lighter inner level, keeping an equal gap between them; fill the gap with the thin firulete line.
composition.density: Rich and nearly full; leave only small dark pockets of contra-field so that the ornament reads as cut out and glossy.
composition.crop_behavior: Keep the whole frame visible inside the image with a thin margin; never crop the panel unless it is shown on a real surface such as a bus side.

typography.headline: Large gothic or ornamented capital letters with fish-tail terminals, painted in one luminous color with a lighter inner band, a darker projected body, a bevel highlight and optional pearl beads.
typography.secondary: Small, clean, upright signwriter capitals in white or ochre with a thin dark outline, set on a ribbon or under the headline.
typography.placement: Center the headline on the axis, on a straight line or a gentle arch; the secondary line sits on a ribbon, a banner or the base of the panel.
typography.spacing: Even letter spacing with generous word gaps; every letter has the same slant and proportions.
typography.rule: Exactly the supplied words, spelled correctly, with no extra letters, numbers or decorative pseudo-text.

color_palette.contra_field: A dark, saturated field behind everything: deep red, black, dark brown or midnight blue, chosen from FIELD_COLOR.
color_palette.main_colors: Luminous green and ochre or gold for the two ornament levels, pink and light blue for flowers and ribbons.
color_palette.highlights: Pure white for stamens, teeth, pearls, repique strokes and bevel highlights; use sparingly so they glitter.
color_palette.shadows: Darker, saturated versions of each color, plus a hard flat cast shadow in near-black on the field.
color_palette.behavior: High saturation and gloss with strong contrast; no pastels, gradients across the whole panel, neon glow or muted film tones.

image_treatment.rendering_mode: Hand-painted synthetic enamel look: crisp opaque outlines, smooth flat color areas and precise brush-stroke highlights.
image_treatment.lighting: Painted light only: top-left light side, shaded opposite side, white highlight strokes; no photographic lighting or ambient occlusion.
image_treatment.finish: Glossy varnished surface with clean edges and tiny reflections; subtle wear is allowed only when the panel is shown on a real vehicle or sign.
image_treatment.texture: Smooth gloss with faint brush direction visible in ribs; no paper grain, halftone or noise overlay.

design_rules: Always enclose the artwork in a painted frame with a visible margin, and keep ornament inside it.
Build symmetry first: mirror leaves, flowers, ribbons and animals around the central axis, or balance a heavier left side with the band on the right.
Give every motif a base color, a light side, a shade side and white highlight strokes, always from the same light direction.
Make the acanthus leaves, volutes and band carry the structure; use flowers, dots, drops and filigree only to fill space.
Paint the lettering as part of the ornament: same colors, same highlights and shadow logic, with a projected body and a cast shadow.
Keep the palette to luminous saturated enamel colors on a dark field, with pure white reserved for highlights.
do: Check that the left and right sides mirror each other and that the gap between the band and the inner level is even.
Vary leaf shapes and directions slightly so the ornament feels dynamic, not copy-pasted.
Add repique strokes, bevel highlights and a hard cast shadow on both ornament and letters.
Change the emblem, words, props and field color in every new case while keeping the system.
Place the exact supplied text on a ribbon, cartouche or central band, large enough to read at thumbnail size.
avoid: Avoid photorealism, 3D render, cinematic lighting, soft airbrush gradients, glow and glitter effects.
Avoid minimalist layouts, wide empty space, pastel palettes and flat vector icons without painted volume.
Avoid asymmetry that looks accidental, uneven margins, cropped frames and floating ornaments with no frame.
Avoid invented words, extra text, brand marks, flags used literally, watermarks and creator handles.
Avoid grunge, xerox, halftone, paper grain and distressed print textures.
negative_prompt: photorealistic scene, 3D render, cinematic lighting, airbrush gradient, neon glow, pastel palette, minimalist layout, flat vector icon, halftone, paper grain, grunge texture, asymmetrical accidental layout, cropped frame, floating ornament without frame, extra text, misspelled text, invented words, logo, brand mark, literal national flag, watermark, QR code, poster mockup
